Supreme Court Questions Centre on IPS Officer Deputations to CAPF

The Supreme Court of India has questioned the central government regarding the deputation of Indian Police Service (IPS) officers to leadership roles within the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF). The court raised concerns about the necessity and justification for these deputations, implicitly questioning the availability of competent officers within the CAPF itself. The specific details of the legal challenge or the exact nature of the court's questioning were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
